app.tagline: Restore old family photos on your own GPU and see what every step changed.
lang.label: Language
demo.banner: This is a demo with real output computed on a GPU. The sliders for faces and colour work, the rest is fixed.
demo.install: Install it to run your own photos
drop.title: Drop a photo or a whole scan
drop.hint: A flatbed scan with several prints works too. Nothing leaves this computer.
examples.title: Try an example
footer.local: Everything stays on this computer. The original file is never changed.
controls.title: Steps
controls.faceHint: 0 keeps the old face. 100 uses what the model draws.
controls.forceFade: Run tone recovery even on good prints
scan.hint: Drag the corners to fix an outline. Each outline becomes its own straightened photo.
scan.none: No outline found, the whole image is used
mask.legend: Red areas will be filled in by the model
result.wholeNote: Finished in {s} seconds. Pick a step to see only what it did.
steps.split.hint: Cut each print out of the scan and straighten it
steps.fade.hint: Restore contrast and remove the colour cast
steps.faces.hint: Rebuild faces and blend by strength
steps.color.hint: Add colour to black and white prints
note.skip.tone: Skipped. The print already uses {used}% of the tonal range.
note.info.tone: The print used {used}% of the tonal range before this step.
note.info.hand_mask: Used the damage mask you edited.
note.skip.mask_large: Skipped. The damage mask covers {percent}% of the print, which is too much to trust. Mark the damage by hand instead.
note.info.color_guess: The colours are the model's guess, not a record of the real ones.
note.skip.has_color: Skipped. The print already has colour.
note.skip.large: Skipped. The print is already very large.
note.info.scale_reduced: Enlarged only {scale}× to keep the file a manageable size.
status.maskDropped: Your hand-painted mask for photo {n} was discarded because the outline changed.
legend.invented: Pink marks pixels the model drew
legend.drag: Drag the line to compare. Scroll to zoom, double click to reset.
